host.description: Server IP address to bind to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: Main UDP port for client connections. Standard for Quake III Arena-compatible servers.

maxclients.description: Maximum number of player slots (including spectators).

map.description: Default map to load on server startup.

dedicated.description: Run as a dedicated server (no local console or graphics).

bind.description: Network interface or IP to bind to for game traffic. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

net_port.description: UDP port for client connections (must match main 'port' unless using a proxy or relay).

maxrate.description: Maximum network bandwidth per client (in bytes/sec). Adjust for dialup or high-latency clients.

rcon_password.description: Password for remote console (RCON). Leave blank to disable RCON. Use strong passwords.

rcon_address.description: IP address to bind RCON to. Use '0.0.0.0' for remote access (not recommended for security).

rcon_tcp_enabled.description: Enable TCP-based RCON. Use only with TLS/proxy for production.

timelimit.description: Match time limit in minutes. 0 means no time limit (frag-based only).

fraglimit.description: Match frag limit. 0 disables frag-based ending (use timelimit or roundlimit).

roundlimit.description: Match round limit. 0 disables round-based ending.

friendlyfire.description: Allow team members to damage each other.

teambalance.description: Automatically balance teams based on player counts.

minplayers.description: Minimum players required to start a match (0 = start anytime).

hostname.description: Server name displayed in the server browser and console.

url.description: Server website URL shown in server browser. Include http(s):// prefix.

allow_download.description: Allow clients to download custom models/sounds/maps from this server.

modelpath.description: Path (relative to base directory) where custom player models are stored.

soundpath.description: Path (relative to base directory) for custom sounds.

mappath.description: Path (relative to base directory) where custom maps are stored.

sv_pausable.description: Allow server pause in dedicated mode (only with -pause flag or RCON).

sv_unlag.description: Enable anti-lag compensation (unlag) for fair play.

sv_unlag_lagtime.description: Maximum time window (in seconds) for unlag prediction. Lower for low-latency networks.

log_file_enabled.description: Enable logging to a file (see logfile setting).

log_filepath.description: Path to the server log file.

log_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) before log rotation. 0 disables rotation.

log_max_files.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

plugins.description: List of plugins to load on startup.

name.description: Plugin name (used for config keys, e.g., 'admin' -> [admin_] config prefix).

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the plugin shared library (.so).

admin_enabled.description: Enable built-in admin system for permissions and authentication.

admin_file.description: Path to admin user/permission configuration file.

admin_autosync.description: Automatically sync ban list and admin files with disk on changes.
